timing_method: MPI.Wtime immediately around the complete public dijkstra() call; parallel Barrier before each call; maximum local elapsed time reduced after stopping the timers.
memory_method: RSS sampled outside timing after each solve; peak RSS is Windows process-lifetime peak working set, including interpreter/MPI setup. Summed per-rank peaks are not a simultaneous aggregate peak.
